title: 7903 Zircon Dr | Home for Sale in Killeen, TX | Elizabeth Thomas - Fort Hood Homes Group
description:
Welcome to 7903 Zircon Dr — a stunningly spacious home with personal touches throughout! Downstairs offers everything you need for comfortable living and entertaining, including a formal dining room, dedicated office, living room, and a beautiful kitchen featuring a large island, double ovens, a breakfast nook, and an additional office or workspace just off the kitchen. You’ll also find a large laundry room with a sink, a mud bench area when entering through the garage, and a sunroom! The master is located downstairs and has a large bathroom with a walk-in shower featuring a rainfall shower head and a large walk-in closet. Upstairs has a huge loft area, a dedicated movie room, and three generous sized bedrooms with two full bathrooms. Step outside to a large backyard complete with a playscape, pergola, and storage shed. When they said everything is bigger in Texas, They were talking about this house!
